entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel Ms. T. Som appearing for the petitioner.

Also heard Ms. N.
Das, the learned Addl. Public Prosecutor representing the State of Assam.
This is an application under Section 397 and 401 of the Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC) challenging the order dated 06.05.2023 passed Page No.# 2/2 by the learned Special Judicial Magistrate,
Kamrup(M), Guwahati in Hatigaon P.S. Case No.594/2018, registered under Sections 120(B)/419/420/468/471/406/34 of the IPC.
Police seized a vehicle bearing Registration No.AS-01-DZ/6292.
The trial court did not give custody of the vehicle to the registered owner on the basis of an objection made by the Investigating Officer.

The Investigating Officer suspected that the vehicle was suspected to be purchased by cheating Abdul Aziz vs The State Of Assam on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109193797/
1 money of the complainant.
Today, the documents supplied by the petitioner shows that he had purchased the vehicle after exchanging his old car and after taking a loan from the financial company.

entities.text: Abdul Aziz vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under the given circumstances of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the vehicle has been unnecessarily kept seized.
Therefore, the custody of the seized vehicle shall be given to the registered owner on taking a bond of 2 lakhs.
The Criminal Revision Petition stands disposed of.
